speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin, could you please describe the specific symptoms you are experiencing and when they first started?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see, so you are experiencing a wide-based, unsteady gait and right-sided limb ataxia. How long have these symptoms been present, and have you noticed any other changes such as speech difficulties, vision problems, or headaches?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: Natalizumab use raises significant concern for Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML), which can present with these neurological deficits. Have you experienced any cognitive changes, confusion, or memory loss recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had a recent fever or major infection that I know of. The symptoms are mostly gait imbalance, limb ataxia, and weaker use of my right arm.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of natalizumab use and these neurological signs, we need to rule out Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy immediately. REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain_with_contrast
